alt: Full Redacted Email Thread — Senator Suzette Valladares' Office Casework
summary: The complete, redacted email correspondence thread with Senator Suzette Valladares' office (Constituent Services Rep Sydney Hill) spanning June and July 2026. Explicitly documents the proactive, good-faith casework initiated by the Senator's staff, and directly exposes that the Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) liaison failed to provide a timely response to the official legislative inquiry regarding the State Fair Hearing and Conlan defaults.
full_text: Complete email thread between constituent Nicolas Hernandez and the office of California State Senator Suzette Valladares. Documents constituent release forms, immediate and proactive follow-ups, and the Senator's office confirming that their official inquiry is currently pending and waiting on an update from the Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) liaison who is stalling the response.
